board_logic._size_note: Surfline quotes WAVE FACE in ft, a different scale from the Aussie back-of-wave metres Uira reads. Size is display-only and must never select a board.
board_logic._no_energy_note: Missing energy reading falls to the daily driver, never the step-up.
board_logic._tier_note: Each tier lists boards in preference order. The engine takes the first TWO that are active:true, so an on-order or retired board degrades gracefully instead of being recommended. Inferno 72 and Inferno FT deliberately share the daily-driver tier (72 primary, FT when walls run fast and clean).
board_logic._synergy_note: Synergy sits between the FT and the FMN3: it takes the powerful-but-not-heavy days the FT was being stretched into, pushing the 6'2 up to genuinely serious surf only. While active:false, tier 2 falls back to the FT — the pre-Synergy behaviour.

wetsuits.name: O'Neill Hyperfreak Fire 3/2
wetsuits.role: Warmest — winter and cold offshore mornings

wetsuit_logic._overlap_note: The two 3/2s overlap at 18-20C. Winter defaults to the warmer suit (first in the list); outside winter the lighter one leads with the warmer offered as the windy/overcast alternate.
wetsuit_logic._fallback_note: Out of range: below the coldest lo use the FIRST suit, above the warmest hi use the LAST. Never index 0 blindly.
